choices.effect: Keeps the style taut and citrus-led, emphasizing acidity, saline freshness and the grape's natural texture without adding wood-derived toast or spice.
Can broaden the texture and add creaminess, toast and spice. Oak maturation is also part of the traditional Nykteri style.
Skin contact and ageing in qvevri can give amber color, more tannin and a broader, savory profile with dried orange peel, spice, tea and stone-fruit notes.
Produces a fresher, lighter expression that keeps citrus, quince, apple and floral notes more prominent and carries much less tannin.
Barrel ageing helps integrate Cabernet's tannin and can add cedar, vanilla, baking spice, mocha and toast. New oak leaves a stronger flavor imprint than older neutral barrels.

choices.context: Required for Crianza, Reserva and Gran Reserva ageing classifications
choices.effect: Softens tannin and adds vanilla, coconut, toast and spice; longer maturation can contribute leather, tobacco and other tertiary complexity.

choices.context: Especially relevant to younger, fruit-first Rioja styles
choices.effect: Keeps red fruit, floral character and freshness more prominent, with less wood-derived vanilla, coconut and toast.
